scope: FP32 public-video development validation, not formal acceptance
teacher_comparison_limitation: Teacher capacity and resolution both differ; this is not a resolution-controlled ablation.
relaxed_caps_limitation: Top-K and final output capacity changed together for diagnosis only; not deployable or accepted results.
decode_limitation: This checks FP32 CNN head decode, not an INT8 CNN implementation.

visual_review.selection: First saved example per category, not a representative annotation audit
observations: A missed person is truncated at the image border.
A vehicle false positive encloses only part of a truck cargo bed.
A vehicle localization error excludes part of the complete car extent.
A person false-positive example overlaps a source motor annotation; the visible rider requires separate-person label policy review before calling it class confusion.
Other visually ambiguous person examples require annotation review; no labels were changed.

recommendation.reason: Both class AP50 values declined and false positives increased; the predefined continuation gate failed.
recommendation.distillation: Worth a short independent controlled trial, not an unconditional long run or accuracy guarantee.
prerequisites: Review rider/person mapping and ignore policy on training data without modifying frozen validation truth
Measure GT-supported teacher coverage on the training split before building a teacher cache
Keep artificial teacher boxes out of human ground truth
recommendation.proposed_trial: Initialize from frozen epoch7, run a separate two-epoch GT-gated distillation trial with a matched supervised control; compare both on full development validation and old256 before expanding to five epochs.
recommendation.proposed_stop_rule: Stop if person AP50 does not improve beyond the matched supervised control or vehicle AP50 regresses; do not extend blindly to 10/15/20 epochs.
recommendation.data_scope: A sparse ground-camera development baseline can be declared separately; selecting successful demo clips is not formal accuracy evidence.
recommendation.authorization: Recommendations only; no new training or label changes in this diagnostic turn.
